title: Design System: IITK Context-Aware Resume Diagnostic Engine

display.purpose: Header title and main brand titles.

label.purpose: Location tags, severity badges, bullet snippets.

shadows.name: ambient-glow
shadows.purpose: Glow under primary buttons and active indicators.

components.name: Primary Action Button
components.description: Main submission button to launch resume analysis.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: linear-gradient(to right, #2563eb, #4f46e5); color: #ffffff; padding: 12px 24px; font-weight: 600; border-radius: 12px; border: none; font-size: 14px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 10px 25px -5px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.25); transition: opacity 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.9; }

components.name: Track Selector Pill
components.description: Target industry track selector button (SDE, Quant, Consulting, Core).
components.css: .ds-role-pill { background: #020617; border: 1px solid #1e293b; color: #94a3b8; padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: 12px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; cursor: pointer; } .ds-role-pill.ds-active { border-color: #3b82f6; background: rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.2); color: #93c5fd; }

components.name: Auto-Detect Banner
components.description: Gradient notification banner displaying the auto-detected best-fit track.
components.css: .ds-banner { background: linear-gradient(to right, rgba(6, 78, 59, 0.8), #0f172a, rgba(30, 58, 138, 0.8)); border: 1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.3); border-radius: 16px; padding: 16px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; color: #fff; } .ds-banner h3 { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 800; margin: 0; } .ds-banner span { color: #34d399; text-decoration: underline; } .ds-icon { width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 12px; background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.2); color: #34d399; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 18px; }

narrative.overview: The SPO Academic Command Center is a high-density, authoritative dark-mode interface designed for IIT Kanpur placement advising. Built to handle complex, multi-column LaTeX resume data, the aesthetic balances academic rigor with modern tech command-center precision.

rules.name: The Rarity of Blue Accent Rule
rules.body: Primary blue fill (#2563eb) is strictly reserved for primary CTA buttons and active track selection. Neutral slate dominates 90% of the viewport.

rules.name: The Monospace Provenance Rule
rules.body: Any text representing extracted resume data (bullet snippets, page numbers, line identifiers, parsed URLs) must use the monospaced font family.

rules.name: The Stroke-First Layering Rule
rules.body: Surfaces rely on 1px subtle slate borders (#1e293b) for visual boundary separation. Heavy box-shadows are strictly forbidden.

dos: Do use JetBrains Mono monospace font for all bullet snippets, line IDs, page numbers, and hyperlinks.
Do highlight the highest-scoring track automatically upon PDF upload with the Auto-Detect Best Fit banner.
Do use 1px slate borders (#1e293b) for structural division across cards and tables.
donts: Don't use light or white backgrounds for card containers; keep the UI in the dark slate palette.
Don't fabricate metrics or experience when suggesting bullet point rewrites.
Don't use heavy drop-shadows or multi-colored gradients on body text.
